title: Rising Sun Martial Arts

services.name: RSMA Summer Camp
services.desc: An awesome experience for your child! RSMA summer camp is open to all children ages 5 and older, regardless of membership status. Campers have fun filled days with weekly themed activities, martial arts training, and outdoor time at the local park, which includes a creek, basketball court, and playground. Don't let your child sit around at home all summer, come and join the fun!! Our camp has been running for over 10 years and has an excellent track record of providing a fun, safe experience for the kids and teens in our community. Your child can come for one week or all summer- or any number of camps in between. Our popular camps FILL UP every summer, so get your kids signed up today!

blurb: Rising Sun Martial Arts, located in Rising Sun of Cecil County, Maryland. Rising Sun Martial Arts was born out of a simple idea: bringing high quality, accessible and affordable martial arts instruction to the entire community. Our unique style, known as Ails-Ha Karate Budo, includes influences from Tae Kwon Do, Aikijuijitsu, Ninpo, Kyoshujitsu, and Verbal Judo.
